text:
maria: quick sync - opened PR #4590 to add a migration note and TF mapping example for tenant labels + a small SLA clarification. tagging infra and docs for a quick pass. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4590
kevin: skimmed. strong +1 on the migration note. one concrete change request: your terraform example uses `label = \"tenant:acme\"` which our TF provider expects as `labels = {\"redwood.tenant\" = \"acme\" }`. can we show both old and new forms and a one-liner migration command?
tara: yep. can we also avoid the word "best-effort" in the SLA? it's vague for customers. maybe say "lower priority preemption may occur; when it does, requests will be retried or routed to fallback per routing policy." keeps it concrete.
simon: adding: call out operational impact in parentheses: (fallback may increase 95th p99 latency; see runbook). link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-fallback
olivia: I added a compact Python snippet for the SDK and a Go equivalent in the PR comments. put the SDK examples under a single "provisioning" section so they stay discoverable.
ryan: from infra: please mention that reserved_pool tag is populated from `labels[\"redwood.tenant\"]` in TF and the mapping script is `tools/labels_to_reserved_pool.py`. also include a small plan output showing the affected resource so reviewers know what's changing.
maria: thanks, I'll add both TF forms, the migration script link, and a short `terraform plan` snapshot. for SLA wording, i'll adopt tara's alternative and add simon's parenthetical.
kevin: nit: in the SDK snippet, filename should be `provisioning.py` and the call is `client.create_pool` (not `create_capacity_pool`) in v0.8. mention the SDK version.
tara: also add a quick example for autoscale cooldown policy that matches the runtime api: `autoscale: {min:2, max:10, cooldown_seconds:120}`. docs currently use `cooldown_s` which confuses users.
ryan: confirm we want namespaced labels only going forward? infra prefers `redwood.*` to avoid collisions. mention deprecation window for old labels if possible.
maria: plan:
- update TF snippet to show old vs new labels + migrate script usage
- swap SDK call name and add version note
- fix autoscale field names to `cooldown_seconds` and add tiny example
- change SLA sentence and add runbook link + SLO note
- paste a sample `terraform plan` output line
I'll push updates in ~2 hours.
doc-bot: PR #4590 requested reviewers @kevin @ryan @tara. Please run `make docs-test` and `scripts/validate-tf-examples.sh` before merge.
kevin: i'll review TF snippet after updates. ryan, can you eyeball plan output then?
ryan: yep, will do. also request: add a single-line FAQ: "What happens to existing freeform labels?" pointing to migration steps.
maria: good call. adding FAQ and a note about how reserved pools are matched (exact label match). thanks all! :rocket:
